colors.gradient_strategy: No flat linear backgrounds. Use deep black #050505 as the base. Create massive, blurred, radial mesh-gradients using #005C5C and #0DF5E3 strategically placed (e.g., top right corner, or glowing behind the hero portrait) with opacity-30. Always overlay a grain/noise texture to kill digital flatness.

typography.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-[5rem] tracking-tighter leading-none font-black uppercase
typography.overline: text-xs md:text-sm font-mono tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-[#0DF5E3]
typography.instructions: NEVER center-align headings by default. Use explicit left or right alignment to create asymmetric tension. Overlines must use the mono font with wide tracking.

visual_enhancers.texture: Add a fixed, full-screen noise/grain SVG overlay with pointer-events-none and low opacity (approx 3-5%) mixed with overlay blend mode to give a premium, tactile feel.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px solid borders (border-white/10) to define layout structure. In the 'Tetris Grid', leave some borders open or use crosshairs (+) at intersections.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Hovering on interactive elements should shift text to #0DF5E3, and add a subtle 0px 0px 15px rgba(13, 245, 227, 0.3) drop-shadow.
visual_enhancers.images: Hero portrait MUST be a composite: Black-and-white portrait of Caleb heavily contrasted, clipped inside a perfect circle, placed OVER a blurry night city background. Or use mix-blend-luminosity to fuse them.

layouts.hero: Kinetic Hero. Left side: Massive typography 'CALEB KREWU' masked and revealed line-by-line using framer-motion on load. Right side: The B&W circular portrait overlapping the blurry neon turquoise city background.
layouts.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for a slow 'Editorial Ribbon' of skills. Pale turquoise text on a deep black background or vice versa. Use JetBrains Mono, uppercase, separated by large dots or plus signs.
layouts.bento_grid: For Certifications. Use the 'Tetris' Grid Mode A. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Mix tall and wide blocks. Do NOT fill perfectly. Leave negative space.
layouts.timeline: For Experience. Left col: mono dates. Right col: content. Connected by a 1px vertical line (border-white/10) with glowing #0DF5E3 dots at each node.
layouts.contact: Asymmetric layout. Left: massive text 'LET\'S TALK'. Right: Shadcn form heavily customized to the 'Retro-Futurism' terminal look. Transparent inputs, 1px turquoise bottom borders, no heavy white backgrounds.

motion.scrolling: MANDATORY: Use '@studio-freight/react-lenis' for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion.reveals: Use framer-motion for viewport-triggered reveals (initial={{ y: 40, opacity: 0 }} whileInView={{ y: 0, opacity: 1 }} viewport={{ once: true, margin: '-100px' }}).
motion.micro_interactions: Buttons should have a subtle text scramble effect on hover or a sweeping 1px turquoise line.

components_to_use: framer-motion (for kinetic typography and scroll reveals)
Shadcn UI (Form, Input, Textarea - MUST be styled dark/transparent with turquoise accents)

hero_portrait.description: Dramatic B&W portrait of Caleb. Apply object-cover and a perfect circular clip-path.

hero_city_bg.description: Blurry neon turquoise night city. Place behind the portrait or as a subtle parallax background for the hero section.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: NEVER use default Inter font for headings. Use Cabinet Grotesk.
Do NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is FORBIDDEN).
Generous spacing is mandatory. Use p-12, p-24, py-32 to create breathing room.
Use layered z-indexes. E.g., text scrolling OVER a fixed background element.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Buttons must not be generic rounded-md blue blocks. Use sharp corners (rounded-none) with 1px turquoise borders, or pill-shaped with terminal styling.
Forms must NOT have a solid white background. Use transparent backgrounds with solid borders.

Do not guess or leave empty placeholders. Use the provided text from the prompt (CAPACITI IT Support Service Desk Technician, Western Cape Government Financial Systems & Administration Intern, Animal Ambulance Operator).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure off-white text on the black/#0A0A0A background meets APCA contrast standards. If placing text over the mesh gradient, ensure readability via text-shadow or a darker overlay.
